RAJ SOLARA← Back to Raj Solara

Ideas, honestly presented.

Raj Solara is a fictional aircraft concept website prepared for an Interactive Front End Development learning project. Project owner: Rajakokila-P.

Purpose

Help curious students and aviation enthusiasts compare design assumptions, customise a concept and explore how solar input affects a simplified battery-energy calculation.

Scope and limitations

No aircraft exists as a result of this website. No flight-control software, booking service, safety certification or engineering feasibility is claimed. All catalogue figures are invented assumptions. The energy lab cannot be used for flight planning.

Your BR101 platform

The supplied Platform BR101 presentation introduces curved wings, a reflective silver skin, solar harvesting, rechargeable energy storage, onboard decisions, obstacle awareness, satellite communication and optical/thermal imaging. Raj Solara translates these ideas into six system topics, an energy-budget exercise and a simulated mission update.

Infinite endurance, zero-latency delivery and uninterrupted coverage are unverified ambitions in that presentation. BR101’s numerical inputs on this site are invented for learning. The original cover retains its embedded Gemini Notebook credit.

Privacy

Only selected aircraft configurations are stored in this browser. Enquiry values are not saved or transmitted. Storage may be cleared using the individual Delete controls or browser site-data settings. No analytics, external fonts or paid APIs are used.

Supplied aircraft gallery

Rajakokila-P supplied the BR101 vision board, two BR202 livery images and BR303 image for this project. They are displayed unchanged, with descriptive alternatives and model-specific captions. These concept illustrations do not establish real aircraft performance or an airline affiliation.

Credits and assistance

The modern British-livery aircraft image was AI-generated. It is shared across the concept cards and does not change with studio selections; the separate schematic does. No government or airline affiliation is implied. Website code, SVG schematics, tests and documentation were generated with OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex assistance. The user supplied the aircraft concept and requested a premium presentation inspired by Britannia Aether; no source files were copied from that project. Review and adapt the project according to your institution’s permitted-assistance rules.

Assessment status

This is a starting implementation, not a graded submission. Human accessibility checks, independent feedback, official validation, genuine development history and final deployed-site testing remain to be completed.
